items.description: Nine underground advertisements show how hackers package alleged access to enterprise VPNs, cloud accounts, software delivery systems, and business applications for sale. items.title: Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents to Automate Network Intrusions and Gain Privileged Access in Under 3 Hour
items.description: Hackers are using ARTEX, an AI-powered penetration-testing framework, to automate intrusions and shorten the time needed to gain powerful access. In multiple attacks linked to Storm-0940, Microsoft observed attackers moving from initial targeting to privileged access in less than three hours, according to research published by ExtraHop on November 15, 2026. items.description: Hackers have compromised government webmail portals and internal applications using Falcon C2, a browser-based command-and-control framework that steals passwords, emails, session cookies, and private communications.
